File API
Note:
This feature is available in
Web Workers
.
Concepts and Usage
The File API enables web applications to access files and their contents.
Web applications can access files when the user makes them available, either using a
file
<input>
element
or
via drag and drop
.
Sets of files made available in this way are represented as
FileList
objects, which enable a web application to retrieve individual
File
objects. In turn
File
objects provide access to metadata such as the file's name, size, type, and last modified date.
File
objects can be passed to
FileReader
objects to access the contents of the file. The
FileReader
interface is asynchronous, but a synchronous version, available only in
web workers
, is provided by the
FileReaderSync
interface.
